title: Jelba.ma
description: A vaccine reminder platform that helps Moroccan families track their children's vaccination schedules with AI-powered voice reminders.
long_description: Jelba.ma is a full-stack web application built in 3 days during a hackathon. It helps Moroccan parents track their children's vaccination schedules with automated AI voice reminders in Arabic, French, and English. The platform features an admin dashboard for health officials to monitor regional vaccination coverage across Morocco with interactive maps and analytics.
features: Automated AI voice reminders in Arabic using ElevenLabs
SMS and phone call notifications via Twilio integration
Multi-lingual support with Arabic RTL, French, and English
Admin dashboard with interactive Morocco map for regional analytics
Vaccination coverage monitoring with Recharts visualizations
Parent portal for managing children's vaccination schedules

title: Kouralink
description: KouraLink is a platform for football enthusiasts. It connects players and teams from all over the world, allowing them to form teams, organize matches, and participate in tournaments.

title: Scrapy
description: A web scraping platform that automates data extraction from multiple sources. Fast, powerful, and easy to use.
long_description: Scrapy is a comprehensive web scraping platform developed during my internship at AlloBaba. It automates data extraction from multiple sources including Pages Jaunes, Orange 118712, and Autoscout24. The platform features a modern web client for managing scraping tasks, a cross-platform desktop application built with Electron, and Python-based microservices backend for efficient and scalable data collection.
features: Web client for managing and monitoring scraping tasks
Multi-source data extraction (Pages Jaunes, Orange, Autoscout24)
Real-time data processing and export capabilities
